notes: Type markers from Adobe AMF 0 (12 Dec 2007). Values are original (kelp, harbor, 7, 1.5). Not copied from the PDF examples.

cases.title: Null
cases.paragraph: The null marker is 0x05. No further bytes follow.

cases.title: Boolean true
cases.paragraph: The boolean marker is 0x01. The next byte is 0x00 for false and any other byte for true.

cases.title: Boolean false
cases.paragraph: A boolean whose value byte is 0x00 is false.

cases.title: Number 7
cases.paragraph: The number marker is 0x00. The next eight bytes are an IEEE-754 double in network byte order. 7 is 0x401c000000000000.

cases.title: Number 1.5
cases.paragraph: Every AMF0 number is a double. 1.5 is 0x3ff8000000000000.

cases.title: String kelp
cases.paragraph: The string marker is 0x02. A 16-bit length in network byte order is followed by that many UTF-8 bytes. kelp is four bytes.

cases.title: Empty string
cases.paragraph: A string length of zero is the empty string.

cases.title: Strict array of two numbers
cases.paragraph: The strict-array marker is 0x0A. A 32-bit count is followed by that many values. There is no end marker.

cases.title: Object n = 7
cases.paragraph: The object marker is 0x03. Each property is a 16-bit name, then a value. The object ends with an empty name and the object-end marker 0x09.

cases.title: Object harbor = kelp
cases.paragraph: A string property is a string value after the property name. The empty name and 0x09 close the object.

cases.title: Empty buffer
cases.paragraph: A value begins with a type marker. An empty buffer is not a value.

cases.title: Number marker without eight bytes
cases.paragraph: A number is the marker plus eight bytes. The marker alone is not a number.

cases.title: Movieclip marker
cases.paragraph: Marker 0x04 is the movieclip type. The specification says this type is not supported. A decoder must not treat it as a value.

cases.title: Object without the end marker
cases.paragraph: An object is closed by an empty property name and marker 0x09. Stopping after the number leaves the object open.

cases.title: Marker 0xFF
cases.paragraph: 0xFF is not an AMF0 type marker.
